high_level_description: A 1600x900 landscape structural draft of a rural meadow with sun-dappled grass, partly cloudy sky, a large ancient oak on the right with a low horizontal branch, a rusted fence on the left background, and a small distant clock tower near the horizon.

style_description.lighting: Bright daylight with soft sun dapples

compositional_deconstruction.background: Pale blue sky with four soft white clouds; green grassy ground with subtle dapples; horizon line at ~y=495.
